public.title: 1. Public (anonymous)
public.cond: Ladder base. TWO TREES: the public tree /c/:club/… (the URL names the view, identity picks what the chrome offers) and the owner tree /c/:club/owner/…; plus /admin. ONE GOLD ACTION per page. Lists (directory, club archive, standings scope) read cab's own session records — no engine walk, no cache. Session, room and owner-session pages are LiveViews that re-render on every write. Guests via /l/:code see the same pages. Footer on every shell page.

user.title: 2. User (signed in)
user.cond: All public pages + an identity: the cabinet at /, My page, /account, join requests, prefilled registration. No club ties needed.

participant.title: 3. Participant (registered speaker)
participant.cond: All public (+ user) pages + own registration on the session page (cancel = remove, until seated), own room row tinted with its motion in a banner. Session-scoped: a guest via /l/:code rides on public, an account on user.

judge.title: 3. Judge (chairs a room)
judge.cond: All participant pages + at the same room URL: Publish motion, Fill ballot / Edit ballot. Powers come from chairing a room.

member.title: 4. Member
member.cond: All user pages + participant/judge by registering + a private club's roster and full standings.

owner.title: 5. Owner (club head)
owner.cond: All member pages and every room's judge powers + the owner tree. The live session page holds the allocator: room count automatic (ceil(people ÷ 9)), people placed by hand only — the seat decides who judges. One People table, one Add a person form; Remove is the only exit and keeps no personal data. A confirmed ballot is edited by the head only — "edit ballot" is the one verb, lock handling is internal.

admin.title: 6. Admin (platform)
admin.cond: Every club's owner tree + all below + /admin: create clubs, change heads, archive. is_admin; 404 for everyone else.

phoenix-api.title: 7. Phoenix API — /api/v1 (cab)
phoenix-api.cond: Every page verb above maps to one of these — same ClubScope ladder (401 signed out, 403 below the tree, 404 unknown). Green = the engine call behind the write. Pages call the same context functions; the JSON API is for integrations.

engine-api.title: 8. Engine API — node :3100 (internal only)
engine-api.cond: Everything a debate produces lives here; only cab calls it. cab records lifecycle facts (name, started_at, rooms_count, finished_at, winner) on its own session row so lists never call the engine; detail pages read engine state once, four reads fanned out. Auth: HS256 JWT {id, isAdmin} minted per request. Never public.
